Class ReportingIntegrationTest

java.lang.Object
com.pos.ReportingIntegrationTest
public class ReportingIntegrationTest extends Object
Standalone report-query checks against a disposable PostgreSQL database. Creates fixture tables in a uniquely named schema and drops that schema afterward. Never point REPORT_TEST_URL at the shared class database.
Author:
Humaid Syed

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
      Seeds disposable fixtures and verifies inventory usage and item sales queries. The connection is closed and the fixture schema is dropped after the checks.
      Parameters:
      args - command-line arguments; not used
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if REPORT_TEST_URL is missing
      Exception - if connection, fixture setup, queries, or cleanup fail
      AssertionError - if a report result does not match the fixtures

    • bindDay

      static void bindDay(PreparedStatement ps) throws SQLException
      Binds the fixture day as a half-open timestamp range in parameters 1 and 2. Includes October 14, 2026, and excludes midnight at the start of October 15.
      Parameters:
      ps - statement whose first two placeholders are the date boundaries
      Throws:
      SQLException - if either timestamp cannot be bound

    • checkUsage

      static void checkUsage(Connection conn) throws SQLException
      Verifies recipe quantities, date boundaries, unused inventory, and item filtering.
      Parameters:
      conn - open connection with its search path set to the fixture schema
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the usage query cannot execute
      AssertionError - if usage totals or filter results differ from the fixtures

    • checkItemSales

      static void checkItemSales(Connection conn) throws SQLException
      Verifies sold quantities and line-price revenue, including toppings and unsold items.
      Parameters:
      conn - open connection with its search path set to the fixture schema
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the item-sales query cannot execute
      ArithmeticException - if a fixture revenue is not an exact integer
      AssertionError - if the sales totals differ from the fixtures

    • check

      static void check(boolean condition, String message)
      Fails an integration check when its expected condition is false.
      Parameters:
      condition - whether the expected behavior was observed
      message - description included in an assertion failure
      Throws:
      AssertionError - if condition is false
